targets.query: MATCH (p:AttackPath) RETURN p.id AS path_id, p.score AS score, p.description AS description, p.status AS status ORDER BY p.score DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Open High-Severity Findings on Internet-Facing Assets

targets.query: MATCH (a:Asset {internet_facing: true})-[:HAS_VULN]->(f:Finding) WHERE f.severity IN ['critical','high'] AND f.status = 'open' RETURN a.name, f.cve, f.title, f.epss, f.kev ORDER BY f.epss DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Choke Points (nodes in multiple high-score paths)

targets.query: MATCH (p:AttackPath)-[:INCLUDES]->(n) WHERE p.score > 0.7 WITH n, count(p) AS pathCount WHERE pathCount > 2 RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.name AS name, pathCount ORDER BY pathCount DESC LIMIT 20
